description: No IO module. The only output primitive is Kernel.dbg's fz_dbg_value, which renders a value (runtime/src/ir_runtime.rs:314-322) through ctx.output (runtime/src/output.rs:17-24, always appends newline). Add a primitive that writes a binary (String.Chars) to the same sink on all three paths, and lib/io.fz.
title: IO.puts/1 writes a string to stdout
